Product 1

Free Colab

Pick one of the eight league reports below. HoopAssistant personalises it for your club and sends it once a week. Every report includes a two team comparison and a one click screenshot for your staff and your social media.

What HoopAssistant does

Sends the report the club chooses, personalised for the club, once a week during the season.

What the club does

Allows HoopAssistant to appear on its social media as a collaborator, and takes part in 3 to 4 collaboration actions per year, such as a graphic post or a statement from the coach. The details are agreed between the club and HoopAssistant.

Shooting, ball security, rebounding and free throws, ranked across the league.

Where every team sits on points scored and points allowed per 100 possessions.

Product 2

Season Pack

Six products, three of data and three of video. The club chooses 1, 2 or 3 of them for the whole season. All video work focuses on your own team.

Data

Reports and dashboards
Pre game

Complete League Analytics

All eight league reports together in one dashboard, with two team comparison and screenshots. Built to prepare the next opponent.

Post game

Lineup Intelligence

Which pairs, trios and five man units worked in the game, from the play by play. Shows who to play together and who to avoid.

Own team

Shot Quality Make

Every made basket rated High, Medium or Low, with paint touch, assisted or not, and quarter. Combine the filters to answer your own questions.

Report plus video of the baskets included. The demo uses sample data.

Video

Analysis of your own team
Video

Ball Reversal Analysis

How many times your team reverses the ball in half court offense, and how efficient you are when you do.

Team level analysis, counting ball reversals per possession and the points per possession that follow, in half court offense only.
Video

Closeout Analysis

What each of your perimeter players does when the defense closes out: shoot or drive, which hand, and what happens on each side.

Short report with clips of every player.
Video

Pick and Roll Analysis

How each of your ball handlers plays the screen: shoot, pass to the roller or kick out.

Team level analysis, with efficiency by type of defense and player pairs, is available as a supplement.

All three video products can also be run on your training sessions, on demand.
